verified_open_unseen_records.description_raw: I respectfully request a Property Maintenance Code inspection for code violations and most importantly request your assistance in directing me to the office in the LV-JC Government that can assist with a health and welfare inspection for the interior of the house owned by Mary and Roy Little at 11702 Sun Beam Court, Louisville KY 40272 Justification for Property Inspection for code violations: 1. The Fence in the Little’s yard fell over into the homeowner's yard, located at 11703 Golden Light Ct, directly behind them. The 11703 Golden Light Ct homeowner propped up the Little’s fence going on almost 2 years ago. I personally asked Mr. Little when he is going to fix the issue because I can see that mess from my home - back yard located at 6618 Sun Ray Drive. Mr. Little’s response, “Yeah, I’ll get that done.” That was almost 2 years ago”. In fact, at that time, the owner of the home at 11703 Golden Light Ct told Mr. Little he would put up a new fence on his backyard property, so Mr. Little wound not have to. Mr. Little’s response. “No, I’ll get to it”. 2. Exterior of the house mold on the siding of the house and on a wooden garbage station rotting until the wood falls off. Justification for health and welfare inspection. 1. The Little’s do not have a weekly garbage service. They bag/save all of their garbage in their garage until it literally stinks to high heaven. After 40 to 60 days of smelling rot coming from inside the garage, they rent a 30-Yard Roll-Off Dumpster which sits in the drive full for about 2 weeks until it is removed. 2. The Little’s air conditioner system stopped working over 3 months ago. The Little’s put in two window units that cover two bedrooms approximately 8 by 9 sq ft which is not sufficient to cool 2,231 sq ft house. 3. I have seen the interior of the House: It is covered in garbage all over the floor and furniture, there is dog facies and urine on the floor(s). Now in less than two months, I have had delivery and cable personnel, when they see me in my back yard ask me, “Hey what’s up with them, I was just in there and I have never seen anything like that in my entire Life.” “It’s beyond disgusting!” Thank you for your time and consideration on this issue.
